mail.nav.label: Email sections
mail.code.unavailable: The email service did not answer in time or was unavailable. The shop tries again until the deadline.
mail.code.rate_limited: The email service asked the shop to slow down. The shop tries again later.
mail.code.rejected: The email service refused this message. It will not be tried again.
mail.code.misconfigured: The email service refused the shop's key or sending domain. Check the server settings.
mail.code.quota_exceeded: The sending quota of the email service is used up. The shop tries again when it renews.
mail.code.idempotency_conflict: The email service saw this message before with other content. It may or may not have been sent.
mail.code.not_sent: Nothing left the shop. The shop tries again.
mail.code.deadline_passed: The mail was not sent before its deadline.
mail.code.template_unavailable: The template of this mail is not available any more.
mail.code.variables_invalid: The stored data no longer fits the template.
mail.code.render_failed: The template could not produce a valid mail.
mail.code.message_invalid: The finished mail was refused by the shop's own checks.
mail.code.unrecognized: An error code this version does not know.
mail.status.intro: Whether the shop can send mail, how much was sent in the last 24 hours and what is waiting.
mail.status.countsCaption: Mails by status in the last 24 hours
mail.status.errorsCaption: Error codes of the last 24 hours with their counts
mail.status.noErrorsBody: No mail of the last 24 hours has an error code.
mail.notConfigured.title: No email provider is configured
mail.notConfigured.body: The shop sends no mail. Orders and accounts work as usual; customers get no password reset or order mails.
mail.setup.title: How to turn email on
mail.setup.step1: Set EMAIL_PROVIDER in the server environment to the code of a provider, for example resend.
mail.setup.step2: Set EMAIL_FROM to the sender, for example Shop Name <shop@your-domain.example>, on a domain verified with the provider.
mail.setup.step3: Set the provider's own key variable named in its README, and STOREFRONT_PUBLIC_URL for the links in mail.
mail.setup.step4: Restart the API, then come back here and send a test email.
mail.setup.secretNote: Keys are set on the server only. They are never typed or shown in this panel.
mail.test.title: Test email
mail.test.intro: Sends a test mail to your own address (the one you sign in with). Up to 5 a hour.
mail.test.disabled: Turn on a provider first: a test mail cannot be sent without one.
mail.test.queued: The test mail is queued. It is sent in a moment.
mail.test.refusedTitle: The test mail was not sent
mail.test.unknownBody: No answer came, so the test mail may or may not have been queued. Look at the messages list before sending another.
mail.unknown.title: No answer
mail.refusal.rateLimited: Too many test mails. Try again later.
mail.refusal.rateLimitedWait: Too many test mails. Try again in {minutes} min.
mail.refusal.email_not_configured: No email provider is configured, so nothing can be sent.
mail.refusal.address_undeliverable: The address of this mail cannot be used in a mail header, so it cannot be sent.
mail.refusal.message_open: This mail is still waiting or being sent. Wait for it to finish, or cancel it first.
mail.refusal.not_resendable: Account mails of customers cannot be resent. The customer asks for a new one.
mail.refusal.template_unavailable: The template of this mail is not available any more, so it cannot be resent.
mail.refusal.variables_invalid: The stored data no longer fits the current template, so the mail cannot be resent.
mail.refusal.not_pending: This mail is not waiting any more, so it cannot be cancelled.
mail.list.intro: Every mail the shop queued, newest first. Addresses are personal data.
mail.list.timeZoneHint: Days are read in your browser's time zone; the last day is included.
mail.list.rangeNotSent: Fix the dates to see the list.
mail.list.dateRange.end_before_start: The last day is before the first day.
mail.list.dateRange.out_of_range: Pick a date between the years 2000 and 2199.
mail.list.caption: Mail messages
mail.list.emptyBody: Mail appears here when the shop queues it: order mails, account mails and test mails.
mail.list.pastEnd: There is nothing on this page any more.
mail.detail.variablesNote: The values the template was filled with. Account mails, tokens, passwords and links are hidden.
mail.detail.variablesTruncated: Only the first values are shown.
mail.resend.title: Resend this mail?
mail.resend.body: A new mail is queued to the same recipient with the current version of the template. This mail stays as it is.
mail.resend.bodyTest: A new test mail is queued to your own address with the current version of the template. This mail stays as it is.
mail.cancel.title: Cancel sending this mail?
mail.cancel.body: The mail will not be sent. This cannot be undone; resend it afterwards if needed.
mail.notice.resent: A new mail is queued. It is sent in a moment.
mail.notice.cancelled: The mail was cancelled and will not be sent.
mail.notice.lost.resend: No answer came, so the resend may or may not have been queued. Look at the messages list before resending again.
mail.notice.lost.cancel: No answer came, so the mail may or may not have been cancelled. The status above shows what the shop has.
mail.templates.intro: The mail templates the shop has, with their versions and languages. Open one to see how it looks.
mail.templates.caption: Mail templates
mail.templates.emptyBody: The shop has no mail templates registered.
mail.preview.title: Preview: {key}
mail.preview.sampleNote: This is the template filled with sample data. Nothing is sent and no real customer data is used.
mail.preview.subject: Subject
